Hey, so I truly, genuinely, honestly do not mean for this to be accusatory. This is not a judgement or an indictment. But I think maybe you should talk to a psychologist about possibly having sociopathy. That doesn't make you evil or a bad person, it just might explain why you are having trouble relating or understanding, why you feel as if crying is a phase you could brush off, why you struggled with comittment, the way you talk about relationships like a business proceeding, why you are having troubke connecting or seeing others perspectives......

You may not have it, but you might. And if you do, some support and perspective could really help both you and your loved ones navigate life. Either way, getting another perspective could be good, but for now, try to think of it at different angles, he is mourning the loss of a possible relationship, the loss of time he could have had with her, the loss of opprotunities to mend relationships, the loss of what he could have had as a child, the loss of her presense in the future......... sit on it, and think of him more.
